author: GameTrailers
description:
Shape Hell according to your morals by placing tiles with real artwork, or become eternally damned. Craft a masterpiece to last forever and keep Satan from fading from human memory. Discover countless combos, forge bonds with demon lords, and unveil the mysteries of a strategy roguelike penance.
Canvas Infernum will be available on PC.
title: Canvas Infernum - Official Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.
Deep Dish Dungeon will be available in Fall 2026. Head over to Steam and add the game to your wishlist.
title: Deep Dish Dungeon - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Final Flavor, a pixel-based dungeon crawler roguelite developed by Dragonroll Studio. Players will head into dungeons with a diverse party of outcasts, slays, bakes, and sautés their way to survive. Find the perfect ingredients, following the footsteps of the legendary chef. Final Flavor is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Final Flavor - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Cursed War DLC Release Date Trailer for Hell Clock, an action hack-and-slash roguelike game developed by Rogue Snail. Players can soon access the latest expansion coming to the game with Cursed War, packed with new challenges to overcome, skills to master, and over 80 new items to build powerful builds. The Cursed War Expansion for Hell Clock is launching on July 14 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Hell Clock - Official Cursed War DLC Release Date Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Playtest Launch Trailer for Kosenki, a fast-paced hack-and-slash combat game developed by Eyeheim Studios. Players will master creative, high-speed battles as Hayato, a broken samurai fighting enemies from a Kosenki-corrupted world and his own inner demons. Kosenki is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam through June 28.
title: Kosenki - Official Playtest Launch Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Play Faster, a precision action platformer developed by Goblimp Games. Players will hone in on fast movement, instant retries, and endlessly replayable runs. Master movement, optimize routes, and climb online leaderboards with built-in speedrunning tools. Play Faster is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Play Faster - Official Gameplay Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Comatose launch trailer for this retro survival horror FPS. In Comatose, explore your decaying mind. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and push forward through the dread. Comatose is available now on PC.
title: Comatose - Official Launch Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Deeplanders, a construction puzzle game developed by SOPA Games. Players will strive to populate the depths and bring light where the sun doesn't reach. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony. Deeplanders is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Deeplanders - Official Gameplay Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style. Check out the Torii: Beyond The Gates trailer for this upcoming 2D platformer Metroidvania game. Torii: Beyond The Gates will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Torii: Beyond The Gates - Official Demo Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Beat the Champions launch trailer for this fast-paced arcade football game where legendary players clash in explosive matches powered by special abilities. No realism — just speed, skill, and pure competitive chaos. Beat the Champions is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Steam.
title: Beat The Champions - Official Launch Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
"SURVIVE my SADISTIC SHOW. An ACTION ROGUELIKE where your performance with COLLECTIBLE CREATURES serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: ENTERTAIN OR DIE!"
Head over to Steam and add Bravo, Gaspar! to your wishlist.
title: Bravo, Gaspar! - Official Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Window Trailer for Kernel Hearts, a hack-and-slash action RPG developed by Ephemera Games. Players will gather allies to eliminate Angels and Gods alike as a band of four magical girls attempting to save a world that's drowning in ashes. Kernel Hearts is launching in September 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Kernel Hearts - Official Release Window Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines amazing gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture! SoulQuest is coming Nintendo Switch in Q3 2026. It is also out now on PC.
title: SoulQuest - Official Nintendo Switch Release Window Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Discover the truth. Bury it deeper. Decide how your agents cover it up before the masses catch on. A choice-driven mystery where witnesses and evidence are in your hands. Failure is just another timeline. Check out the trailer for The Outer Frame to see more from this point-and-click narrative puzzle game. The Outer Frame will be available on PC. A Playtest begins in Q3 2026.
title: The Outer Frame - Official Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase SGF Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for Below, a claustrophobic first-person horror game from Gamedev Guy. Explore an ancient Egyptian tomb, armed only with your camcorder as you creep through the darkness avoiding the horrors lurking in the shadows. 
Below is out now for PC (Steam).
title: Below - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
This Sunday, June 7, our yearly double feature returns, offering you a look at what’s next from XBOX and our incredible partners across the world. The XBOX Games Showcase 2026 kicks off at 10am Pacific / 1pm Eastern / 6pm UK, immediately followed by Gears of War: E-Day Direct – presented by The Coalition, creators of the next mainline entry in one of XBOX’s most iconic franchises.

#IGN #Xbox #SummerOfGaming
title: XBOX Games Showcase and Gears of War: E-Day Direct Livestream

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this brand new trailer for Dragon Ball Z Kakarot Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2! This new DLC adds Vegeta Mini as an all new playable character, and all new enemies. 
Dragon Ball Z Kakarot Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Dragon Ball Z Kakarot - Offical Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 DLC Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Build your Monument of Triumph. Watch the latest Destiny 2 trailer to see what to expect with the Monument of Triumph update, which brings new and updated content, including Pantheon, Sparrow Racing League, Distortions, and new Triumph pursuits celebrating your Guardian’s journey across Destiny 2. Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph update will be available to all players on June 9, 2026.
title: Destiny 2 - Official Monument of Triumph Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Battlefield 6 Season 3 is getting more explosive! Introducing the Blastpoint update, featuring new modes, a new map, new weapons and gadgets. In Obliteration, the returning Battlefield 4 mode coming in this update, battle for control of a single bomb, which needs to be taken to the enemy teams bombsite. Teamwork is required to maintain control of the bomb as it spawns in a random location each time. This explosive action can be enjoyed in Bazaar, a map inspired by Battlefield 3's Grand Bazaar. 

The Blastpoint update goes live June 9th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Battlefield 6 - Official Blastpoint Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Delightful agony awaits. Thresh takes the spotlight in this latest 2XKO gameplay trailer for the free-to-play fighting game from Riot Games. Take a look at this new champ in action! In 2XKO, fight solo or with a friend in explosive 2v2 showdowns, mastering a range of powerful champion abilities and unique tag mechanics to take down the enemy duo.

2XKO is available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Thresh joins the fight on June 9, 2026.
title: 2XKO - Official Thresh Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for Infinite Ruins, an incremental mining game from Kileka Games. Mine resources and conver them to create new tools and allies as you mine deeper and deeper, unlocking more and more! 
Infinite Ruins is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Infinite Ruins - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for the latest entry in Nacon and Cyanide Studios racing-sim; Tour de France 2026. Featuring updated teams, routes and climate changes that affect your race management. 

Tour de France 2026 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Tour de France 2026 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this walkthrough trailer for Ace Combat 8 from Bandai Namco. Get a sneak peek at the all new story, the intense dog fighting, the customisation and the different pilots who will join you in your mission! 

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 2nd, 2026.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Walkthrough Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Spyder: Agent 8, a stealth action-adventure game developed by Sumo Digital. Players will embark on a grand retro-futuristic 1970s thriller adventure as Agent 8, a precious robotic spider fitted with the latest in spy technology. Solve environmental puzzles, make use of an array of gadgets, and save the world from an evil organization. Spyder: Agent 8 is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Spyder: Agent 8 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Cinematic Trailer for Backyard Baseball, the upcoming return of the classic arcade baseball game developed by Mega Cat Studios. Players will experience a new iteration of the hit series with new game modes, gameplay improvements, and more, alongside online multiplayer available at launch. Don't miss this flashy, cinematic look at Backyard Baseball, launching on July 9 for PC (Steam) with a release on consoles coming later in Summer 2026.
title: Backyard Baseball - Official Cinematic Trailer
